mentions.name: The Time Game
mentions.description: A multiplayer card/board game built with Unity (C#) using Unity's Relay and Lobby services, designed with the complexity and mind-bending gameplay to appeal to fans of Magic: The Gathering and Hearthstone.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a multiplayer card/board game with some friends! We've been using Unity (C#) and its services like Relay and Lobby.
mentions.author: testerdread
